m: उद्-रेक m. abundance, overplus, excess, preponderance, superiority, predominance, MBh.; Suśr.; VarBṛS. &c.
a: उद्रेकः — 1 Increase, excess, preponderance, abundance; ज्ञानोद्रेकाद्विघटिततमोग्रंथयः सत्त्वनिष्ठाः Ve. 1. 23; गत्वोद्रेकं जघनपुलिने Śi. 7. 74; so मोह˚, धन˚, मद˚. --2 Commencement, outset. --का The plant (महानिंब). --Comp. --भंगः discouraging a thing at the very beginning.

m: उद्रेकिन् mfn. excessive, violent, Sāh.
(ifc.) abounding in, giving preponderance, Suśr.

उद्-√ रिच् Pass. -रिच्यते (pf. -रिरिचे, RV.) to be prominent, stand out, exceed, excel, preponderate, RV. i, 102, 7; vii, 32, 12; to increase, abound in: Caus. -रेचयति, to enhance, cause to increase, Rājat.
a: उद्रिच् — (chiefly used in pass.) 1 To excel, surpass (with abl.); ममैवोद्रिच्यते जन्म-तव जन्मनः Mb. --2 To increase, exceed, preponderate. --3 To abound in.

increased, augmented, abundant, abounding, excessive
superfluous, left, remaining, TS. vii; ĀśvŚr.; MBh.; Mn. &c.
a: उद्रिक्त — p. p. 1 Increased, excessive, abundant. --2 Distinct, evident.

intoxicated, L.

उद्रिन् mfn. abounding in water, RV.

उद्-√ रुच् Ā. (impf. 2. sg. -अरोचथास्) to shine forth, AV. xiii, 3, 23.

undermining, rooting up, Pāṇ.; Ragh. (cf. कूलम्-उद्रुज.)
a: उद्रुज — a. 1 Destroying, breaking down. --2 Undermining (as a bank); as in कूलमुद्रुज q. v.
